title: Are There Flying Fish in Madeira?
description: Yes. Flying fish live in the open water around Madeira and turn up on boat trips all year. From a moving boat they look like silver darts skimming the sea.
heroAlt: An Atlantic flying fish gliding low over deep blue water beside a boat's wake
keywords: are there flying fish in Madeira
how far can flying fish glide
what you see from a boat in Madeira
